candidate-composition.title: Compose accepted candidates
candidate-composition.intro: Create one integration task from fixed accepted code candidates. Its combined result needs its own independent tests and explicit task review.
candidate-composition.no_workflows: Publish a workflow with one producer and independent candidate tests first.
candidate-composition.producer_help: The chosen command or agent node becomes the trusted composition producer. Existing independent test gates remain in the workflow.
candidate-composition.sources_help: Choose 2–16 distinct tasks. The order is fixed in the preview; source tests do not test the new combined result.
candidate-composition.no_sources: No eligible accepted candidates are available. Complete the source tasks' independent tests and formal acceptance first.
candidate-composition.selection_changed: A selected source changed. Remove it and select its current candidate again before preparing a new preview.
candidate-composition.preview_help: Preview fixes the task, workflow and ordered sources. It creates no run and changes no target branch.
candidate-composition.read_only: You can read the current facts and history. Preparing a new composition is unavailable under the current authority or task state.
candidate-composition.start_help: Starting creates one managed run. The Runner composes the fixed sources, then the original workflow independently tests that exact candidate.
candidate-composition.start_ack: I reviewed these fixed sources and authorize one composition run with its independent tests.
candidate-composition.not_acceptance: Composition success and passed tests do not formally accept this task or change the target branch.
candidate-composition.open_run: Open actual composition and test run
candidate-composition.review_help: The run is awaiting formal review. Open this task and explicitly accept its exact run using the existing review gate.
candidate-composition.conflict_help: The fixed sources conflict. No clean candidate is produced. Inspect the actual paths and original run before preparing a reviewed repair.
candidate-composition.failed_help: The original run failed. Open its persisted evidence; no replacement run is started automatically.
candidate-composition.unknown_help: The outcome is uncertain. Reconcile the original run before starting another composition or treating its candidate as accepted.
candidate-composition.accepted_help: This composition task is formally accepted. Governed target integration and downstream baseline binding remain separate explicit actions.
candidate-composition.baseline_help: Bind this accepted combined candidate to an unstarted task. Its next dispatch or an explicit pending-plan revision freezes this input; no downstream run starts here.
candidate-composition.no_tasks: No other task is loaded. Create the intended downstream task through the existing task workspace.
candidate-composition.binding_unavailabl: This task cannot accept a code baseline under the current authority or execution state.
candidate-composition.bind_ack: I reviewed this exact accepted candidate and confirm changing the unstarted task's baseline. Old previews become invalid; existing runs are unchanged.
candidate-composition.bound: The task baseline was updated. Explicitly revise any pending expert-plan item before dispatching with this new input.
candidate-composition.no_history: No composition history for this task.
candidate-composition.recovery: A write has an uncertain response. Restore its original request and operation key; do not create a replacement run or baseline change.
candidate-composition.invalid_read: The response does not match this project's fixed composition or baseline. Refresh the original scope.
candidate-composition.refresh_failed: Current facts could not be read. Your draft is retained; refresh the original scope before confirming again.
candidate-composition.reason.changed: The composition changed. Read the current fixed preview.
candidate-composition.reason.source: Source acceptance or the fixed candidate changed.
candidate-composition.reason.template: Choose a supported workflow with one producer and independent candidate tests.
candidate-composition.reason.base: The selected sources do not share the administrator anchor.
candidate-composition.reason.expired: This preview expired. Explicitly prepare a new preview.
candidate-composition.reason.authority: The original initiating credential is no longer authorized.
candidate-composition.reason.baseline: The code baseline changed or its source is no longer accepted.
candidate-composition.reason.started: A code baseline can only be changed for an unstarted task.
candidate-composition.reason.unknown: Reconcile the original composition run first.
candidate-composition.no_accepted_compos: No eligible accepted composition is loaded. Complete its independent tests and formal task review first.
candidate-composition.pending_baseline_h: Changing the task baseline requires an explicit revision of this unstarted plan item. Code is not inherited automatically.
candidate-composition.input_boundary: These are recorded code inputs and host Git facts. They do not replace independent tests, formal review or target integration receipts.
candidate-composition.input_invalid: The code input facts do not match this workspace. Inspect the original run; no inheritance or composition success is inferred.
